docs.purpose: The form on which an admin uploads one image: its kind (report image or ad creative), for a report image the scenario key and position, the alt text, and the file (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to the configured size).
docs.data_story: It writes one media_assets row and one object in the private surface-media bucket, with one admin_audit_log row, through the upload contract.

limitations.what: The admin_audit_log row this surface writes cannot be named in emits.ledger_events[].
limitations.measured: surface.schema.json's emits.ledger_events[] is closed to usage_events events; admin_audit_log is the second append-only ledger with no token, so emits.answer is "ledger" and the audit row is carried in breadcrumbs[] plus a ledger_row_present check (the admin_placements precedent).

notes: MF-37. scenario_key uses the text widget: the scenario keys (report-v2-seed/row-presentation.json, e.g. detached_house/pitched) contain "/", which the select option rule ([a-z0-9_]+) refuses; the request schema still closes the value with an enum.
